title: Comptime Polymorphism
description: Write a Zig program that demonstrates compile-time polymorphism by creating a generic 'Animal' interface using comptime and inline functions.
verificationTest: output.includes('Buddy says Woof!') && output.includes('Whiskers says Meow!')
hints: `anytype` in function parameters allows accepting any type, with monomorphization at comptime
Use `@TypeOf()` to get the type of a value at compile time
`@typeInfo()` returns the compile-time type information for validation
